name: DHC-2 Beaver
summary: Rugged radial-engined bush plane, the classic Alaskan and Pacific Northwest floatplane workhorse.

wings: High wing braced by a single strut per side
engines: Big round radial engine in a short cowl
fuselage: Boxy, slab-sided fuselage with large doors on both sides
Tailwheel gear or, very often, floats
tail: Angular fin and rudder with straight edges

tellTales: Round radial nose on a boxy high-wing bush plane

confusedWith.howToTell: The 180/185 is smaller with a flat-engine cowl; the Beaver has a round radial nose and boxy fuselage.
The Kodiak has a long turboprop nose and tricycle gear; the Beaver has a short radial nose and a tailwheel.
The 206 has a flat-engine cowl, tricycle gear and a swept fin; the Beaver has a radial and an angular fin.
The Otter is the larger aircraft with a three-blade prop; the Beaver has a two-blade prop and is noticeably smaller.
The Porter has a long, tapering turboprop nose; the Beaver has a short round radial nose and a two-blade prop.
